subject: Your University Account Password Has Been Reset
body:
Dear $first_name $last_name,

An administrator has reset the password for your University account.

Your new sign-in details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Username: $username
Temporary Password: $temp_password
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IMPORTANT: For security purposes, you will be required to change this temporary password the next time you log in.

If you did not expect this change, please contact the IT Helpdesk immediately.

Useful Contacts:
- IT Helpdesk: it.help@$email_domain
- HR Department: hr@$email_domain

Best regards,
University Administration Team
